patch_description: Instead of building large neighborhoods and screening a small batch with surrogate energy, this approach spends the LP budget on a continuous set of single proposals. Four Metropolis-style search chains use different temperatures: cooler chains refine good networks, while hotter chains accept uphill moves and explore other regions. Proposals usually swap destinations on two links, preferentially involving an LP-identified bottleneck; occasional three-link rotations and short compound moves help escape two-switch traps. Repaired QAOA samples seed the chains, with surrogate energy used only to diversify and rank initial starts. The best LP-scored network is retained throughout.
